subject: Provisional approval request: 3 GTM seats (AE, Sr SE, CS Manager) + comp bands
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Provisional approval request: 3 GTM seats (AE, Sr SE, CS Manager) + comp bands

Team —

We have a time-sensitive ask to accelerate hiring for three priority Go-to-Market roles tied to the Q3 enterprise push. I am requesting provisional approvals so People Ops can open reqs and we can start outreach this week. Rough summary below and a short justification in the attached PDF.

Roles requested (headcount source: reallocate two interim contractor seats + 1 new seat request):
- Account Executive (IC quota role) — 1 headcount
  - Proposed band: $130k–$170k base + OTE 2.0x
  - Reason: Two inbound pipeline opportunities from NimbleBank and related accounts; need quota-carrying AE to convert in Q3.
- Senior Solutions Engineer — 1 headcount
  - Proposed band: $165k–$205k base + equity
  - Reason: Required for complex pre-sales technical evaluation for enterprise prospects; existing contractor coverage ends March.
- Customer Success Manager (mid-market team lead) — 1 headcount
  - Proposed band: $150k–$180k base + bonus
  - Reason: To onboard a cluster of expected renewals and expansions tied to the same pipeline.

Attachments: headcount_request_proposal.pdf (business case) and comp_bands_v1.xlsx (proposed bands by market).

Ask: please confirm provisional approval (yes/no) and any immediate band adjustments by EOD Friday 2/12 so we can file the reqs with People Ops. If approved, I will route job specs to Korell Talent for priority sourcing.

Thanks —
Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 07:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Provisional approval request: 3 GTM seats (AE, Sr SE, CS Manager) + comp bands

+1 to moving fast here. AE makes sense at the top end for SF/NY postings — I'd recommend bumping the AE band ceiling to $175k base in high-cost markets and confirming total OTE expectation in the job desc. SE band looks right given scope.

If we can commit to the contractor seat conversions, I support provisional approval today so the recruiting slate can start.

-Ben

Finance can provisionally approve the reallocation of the two contractor seats to full headcount for the AE and CSM roles on the condition that: 
- Recruiting posts for the adjusted bands as noted (AE band ceiling to $175k in SF/NY only).
- We receive job req IDs and proposed start dates (earliest/target).
- Any offers above the top of band will route to compensation committee for sign-off.

Please add the following to the request packet and loop me back: updated comp_bands_v2.xlsx, HC tracker entry with cost center mapping, and a short hiring timeline (2–3 bullets). Once I have those I will route to CFO for final budget sign-off — can do that same day if packet is complete.
